title: Now (November 2026)
summary: What I'm doing now. November 2026 edition
content:
Doing...

We've had a household full of illnesses including colds, flus, an ear infection for Baby Knight, plus an ear infection for me that landed me in A&E but I think we're finally coming to the end of it all. Just in time for full winter illness season.

We went to We Shine which is light installations in various places around Portsmouth. The adults were cold and bored but the kids had a great time. There was a wall for the kids to write on in neon pens which was filled with various versions of "67" but I was pleased to see the Cool S is still in rotation.

Making...

I'm working on a LAMY Safari/AL-Star special edition reference site in a similar vein to the Mildliners site. It's a bit more complicated because I want to toggle the cap on and off, plus they can have seven choices per pen (cap, clip, grip, barrel, transparent barrel, ring, and nib).

I updated the Mildliner site to include the new Mildliner minis which come in two sets of 10 but no new colours.

The card game has taken a back seat for now but I'm still mulling ideas over for it.

Playing...

I caved on buying GTA as soon as the reviews dropped and I've been having a ton of fun with it. The level of detail in everything is incredible.

Listening...

Nothing new in the past month or so but I've been back into the archives and I'm listening a lot to Every Avenue's album Shh. Just Go With It which has one of my favourite songs on it — "Think of You Later (Empty Room)" as well as Last Stop Suburbia by Allister. Nothing like some early 2000s pop rock to keep you going.

Watching...

We just started up Gavin and Stacey as is tradition around this time of year. This quote from Bryn in the first episode is perfection:

Now, you’ve met me halfway on the rape alarm, at least have the decency to let me give you a demonstration. Because, I’ll tell you this for nothing: you come back Sunday, raped, and I showed you how to use it, I’ll rest easy in my bed. You come back Sunday, raped, the fault will lie solely at your door.

Need to find some Christmas movies to watch with the Knightlings; I think Baby Knight might be ready for Muppets Christmas Carol.

Writing with...

I picked up two new limited edition LAMY Safaris: the 2020 Mango and 2018 All Black.
